title: Mem-Forever: a Git-native persistent memory layer for AI agents
description: Every AI tool forgets a user when the session closes. Mem-Forever keeps the memory in the user's own Git repository as compact I-Lang structures that a person can read and a machine can parse, so preferences, decisions and lessons survive across sessions, tools and models. It needs no installation and no configuration: fork the repository and point the agent at it. Documentation in nine languages.
